objective: Define the clean-checkout dependency boundary for ITA and common_cells before any new ITA build/run/compare measurement is promoted.

current_clean_checkout_observation.policy: third_party/ITA and third_party/common_cells are canonical only through their .gitmodules entries and gitlink commits; other local untracked dependency directories are not source of truth.

selected_boundary.first_allowed_seed_after_boundary: one of ita_dotp or ita_softmax_top, not both in the same measurement gate

required_before_ita_measurement: Keep third_party/ITA canonical in .gitmodules at the selected gitlink commit.
Keep third_party/common_cells canonical in .gitmodules at the selected gitlink commit.
Keep the clean-checkout contract test validating the selected dependency paths and required source files.
Keep repo-specific RTL harnesses and manifests under overlays/ITA, not under third_party.
Select exactly one first ITA seed for the first measurement gate.
Keep recursive Bender dependencies out unless a narrow missing module requires them and the gate records why.
excluded_from_this_gate: Adding submodules beyond third_party/ITA and third_party/common_cells
Promoting untracked local third_party/ITA or third_party/common_cells contents as canonical source
Adding a second active seed measurement
Changing runtime or LLVM pass behavior
Writing generated reports or artifacts as source of truth
non_claims: not approval to recursively import all Bender dependencies
not promotion of ita_dotp and ita_softmax_top together
not a speedup or correctness claim for ITA
